title: Cohen rings exist
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number and $k$ a field of characteristic $p$. Then there exist a *Cohen ring* $\Lambda$ (Stacks Algebra, Definition 0327): a discrete valuation ring (a local principal ideal domain which is not a field) whose maximal ideal is $p\Lambda$ and which is $p\Lambda$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] (the canonical map $\Lambda\to\varprojlim_n\Lambda/p^n\Lambda$ is bijective); and a ring isomorphism $\Lambda/p\Lambda\xrightarrow{\sim}k$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0328 (lemma-cohen-rings-exist, line 44878) and its proof; Cohen ring: Definition Tag 0327 (definition-cohen-ring, line 44872)
